# Tabs in the bootstrap look

Its parts, props and data attributes: [Tabs](https://menhir-ui.com/docs/components/tabs.md).

## TabsExample.tsx

```tsx
import { Tabs } from "menhir/tabs";
import { For } from "solid-js";

import styles from "./tabs.module.css";

const sections = [
  {
    value: "account",
    name: "Account",
    content: "Your name, email address and language.",
  },
  {
    value: "billing",
    name: "Billing",
    content: "Your plan, payment method and invoices.",
  },
  {
    value: "security",
    name: "Security",
    content: "Your password, passkeys and signed-in devices.",
  },
];

export default function TabsExample() {
  return (
    <Tabs.Root class={styles.tabs}>
      <Tabs.List aria-label="Settings" class={styles.list}>
        <For each={sections}>
          {(section) => (
            <Tabs.Tab value={section.value} class={styles.tab}>
              {section.name}
            </Tabs.Tab>
          )}
        </For>
      </Tabs.List>
      <For each={sections}>
        {(section) => (
          <Tabs.Panel value={section.value} class={styles.panel}>
            {section.content}
          </Tabs.Panel>
        )}
      </For>
    </Tabs.Root>
  );
}
```

## tabs.module.css

```css
/* Bootstrap's .nav-tabs: tabs on a line, the selected one joined to its
   panel by a border on three sides. A Panel that is not selected is hidden
   by its hidden attribute. */
.tabs {
  width: 20rem;
}

.list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  border-bottom: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color);
}

.tab {
  margin-bottom: calc(-1 * var(--bs-border-width));
  padding: var(--spacer-2) var(--spacer-3);
  border: var(--bs-border-width) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius) var(--bs-border-radius) 0 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--bs-link-color);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    color 0.15s ease-in-out,
    background-color 0.15s ease-in-out,
    border-color 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.tab:hover,
.tab:focus-visible {
  /* Above its neighbours, so that the whole border shows. */
  isolation: isolate;
  border-color: var(--bs-secondary-bg) var(--bs-secondary-bg)
    var(--bs-border-color);
  color: var(--bs-link-hover-color);
}

.tab:focus-visible {
  outline: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--bs-focus-ring-width) var(--bs-focus-ring-color);
}

.tab[data-selected] {
  border-color: var(--bs-border-color) var(--bs-border-color) var(--bs-body-bg);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-emphasis-color);
}

.tab[data-disabled] {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  cursor: default;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.panel {
  padding: var(--spacer-3);
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius);
}

.panel:focus-visible {
  outline: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--bs-focus-ring-width) var(--bs-focus-ring-color);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .tab {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```
